short.en: Click a cell, wire it in

t.zh: 从这一章起，计算交给一个小机器人。它会一格一格地走过整张表，在每一格上做同一件事。
t.en: From this chapter on, the computing is done by a little robot. It walks through the whole table cell by cell and does the same thing on every cell.

t.zh: 这一关只有一排格子，最左边那格已经写好了一个数。机器人从第 2 格出发往右走，每到一格，就把左边那格的数抄过来。
t.en: This level has a single row of cells, and the leftmost one already holds a number. The robot starts on cell 2 and walks right, and on each cell it copies the number from the cell to its left.

t.zh: 机器人怎么知道要抄左边？靠你接的电路板。输入栏里是机器人的视野：中间红框是它脚下的格子，结果就写在这里。电路板左边的视野元件就是它：在视野里点「左边」那一格，元件上就多一个输出口，把那一格的数送进电路板。
t.en: How does the robot know to copy from the left? From the circuit board you wire up. The inputs pane shows the robot’s view: the red frame in the middle is the cell it stands on, where the result is written. The View part on the left of the circuit board is that view: click the “left” cell, and the part gains an output that brings that cell’s number into the circuit.

t.zh: 最后，从输入「左边」底部的圆点拖一根线，接到电路板最下面红框的「本格」。意思是：左边送来几，本格就写几。也可以先点一个圆点，再点另一个。
t.en: Finally, drag a wire from the dot under the “left” input to “this cell”, the red-framed output at the bottom of the board. It means: whatever comes from the left, write it in this cell. You can also click one dot and then the other.

goal.zh: 让机器人把最左边格子里的数，一格一格抄到最右边：每一格都等于它左边那一格。
goal.en: Have the robot copy the number in the leftmost cell, cell by cell, all the way to the right: every cell equals the cell to its left.

how.zh: 在视野里点「左边」那一格，视野元件上多出一个输出口，把它连到「本格」，然后点「运行测试」。
how.en: Click the “left” cell in the view: the View part gets an output for it. Wire that to “this cell”, then click “Run tests”.

say.zh: 第 1 步：在视野里点「左边」那一格，「视野」元件上就多一个输出口。
say.en: Step 1: click the “left” cell in the view, and the “View” part gains an output.

say.zh: 第 2 步：从「视野」元件右边的圆点拖一根线，接到「本格」。
say.en: Step 2: drag a wire from the dot on the “View” part’s right to “this cell”.

say.zh: 第 3 步：点「运行测试」，看机器人一格一格地抄过去。
say.en: Step 3: click “Run tests” and watch the robot copy its way along, cell by cell.

say.zh: 机器人从左往右走，到一格时它右边的格子还空着，不能读。
say.en: The robot walks from left to right, so when it reaches a cell, the cell to its right is still empty and can’t be read.

hints.zh: 在视野里点「左边」，再把「视野」元件上多出来的输出口连到「本格」。
hints.en: Click “left” in the view, then wire the new output on the “View” part to “this cell”.

body.zh: 你只接了一根线，机器人就在每一格上照做了一遍。电路板就是规则：只写一次，机器人在每一格上都用它。
body.en: You drew a single wire, and the robot carried it out on every cell. The circuit board is the rule: you write it once, and the robot uses it on every cell.

note.zh: 电路板描述一格的规则，机器人在每一格上运行它。
note.en: A circuit board describes the rule for one cell; the robot runs it on every cell.
